documents.title: Lawrence County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 55 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Article 5 appropriations (pp. 52-54) for every office and fund; category subtotals from the 2026 budget detail (pp. 1-45). The summary (pp. 46-49) has 2025 and 2026 columns; we used it only to cross-check. column.
